segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: We’re glad you came this morning.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Me too.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Me and you are going to talk all Cherokee for a little while.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Alrighty.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏄᏰᎵᏛ ᎯᎢᎾ ᏥᎾᏛᏁ ᎯᎢᎾ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏧᏂᏙᏢ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏗ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᏗ ᏳᏅᏙᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᏍᏊ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏗ ᎯᎢᏃ ᏥᎩ ᏥᏂᏬᏂ ᏍᏊ ᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎸᏍᏗ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ

segments.translation: The reason we’re doing this, is here that made this place to teach and learn Cherokee. It’s for them to listen to and learn from it. Just the way the language is now, like me and you are talking, it's supposed to be here for a few years.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏓ Ᏺ ᏂᏣᏛᏁ Ꮩ ᎮᎾ Ᏺ ᎤᏚᎵᏗ ᏥᏈᏍᏓᏅ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ Ꮭ ᎬᏂᏬᏂ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᎾᏔ ᏄᏰᎵᏛ ᎠᏎᏅ ᎤᏖᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁ ᏍᏊ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ

segments.translation: You all are doing good. We really need that. A lot of people these days can’t talk, I don’t know why. But you all are doing good. Keep doing it.

segments.translation: To listen to?

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Listen to.

segments.translation: Michael D. Pritchett.

segments.translation: Now in Cherokee?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Saloli.

segments.translation: Saloli.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.text: ᏙᏅ.. ᎦᏙᎲ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎢᎾ ᎦᏥᏯᏛᏛᎾ ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᎦᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᎾ ᏌᎶᎵ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏱᎨᎮ ᏄᏰᎵᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏦᎲ

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: ᎠᎩᎵᏏᏛ ᎠᏪ.. huh Ꮭ ᏯᏩᎾᏔ ᎤᏥᏈᏍᏛ ᏙᎩᏲᎲ ᏌᎶᎵ ᏍᎩᎾ yep ᎥᎩᏁᎸ ᏓᏩᏙᎠ ᎠᏎᏅ ᏍᎩᏅ ᏣᎩᏁᎸ my ᎠᎩᎵᏏ ᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ

segments.translation: My grandma. I don’t know, we were always hunting squirrels. I guess she gave it to me. She’s the one who gave me the name a long time ago.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: They would get from somewhere uh uh…

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Really now.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎩᎶ.. ᎩᎶ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᎭ ᏱᏚᏃ uh.. ᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ

segments.translation: …someone’s Cherokee name a long time ago.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yep.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Whereabouts were you born?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Ꮎ.. ᎠᎭᏂᏛ ᏓᎵᏆ ᎠᏩᏕᏅ uh.. September the 10th 1962 ᎠᏎᏅ BunchᎢ ᎮᎾ ᏗᏢ Ᏺ ᎪᎯᏓᏅ ᎪᎢ ᏗᏩᏕᎶᏆᎥ ᏃᏭᏅ Cave Springs ᏓᎩᏍᏆᏛ
segments.transliteration: na.. ahanidv daliqua awadenv uh.. September the 10th 1962 asenv Bunchi hena ditlv yo gohidanv goi diwadeloquav nowunv Cave Springs dagisquadv
segments.translation: I was born here in Tahlequah, September 10, 1962, toward Bunch. For a long time, I went to Greasy school, then I finished up at Cave Springs.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: Ꮩ.. Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎥᎾᎾ uh.. BunchᎢ ᏗᏢ ᏣᏛᏒ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏂᏥᏤᎲ

segments.translation: What was it like back then, growing up in Bunch?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏓ Ᏺ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮭ.. uh.. ᏥᏄᏍᏓ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ Ꮩ ᎮᎾ Ꮭ ᏱᎨᎵᎮ ᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ Ꮎ.. ᎦᏛᏍᎬ ᎠᏎᏅ ᎠᎩᎵᏏ ᎮᎾ ᎠᎩᏃᏎᎲ ᎯᎾᏏ ᏥᎬᏰᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᏛᏣᏍᏕᎸ ᎮᎾ ᎠᏛᏍᎬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏥᏂᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏩᎦᏔᏪ Ꮷ.. uh.. ᎤᏲᏢ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎲ ᎭᏛᏍᎬ ᏣᏓᎦᏎᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎮᏍᏗ ᎫᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎦᏔ Ꮎ.. ᏚᏳ.. ᏚᏳᎦᏔ ᏂᎨᎲᎾ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ ᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᏣ.. ᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᏖᎳᏗ ᎮᏍᏗ Ꮩ ᏥᎬᏰᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏚᏳᎦᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏏᏅ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏱᎩ ᎫᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎦᏛᏁ Ꮕ.. Ꮕ.. ᎢᏅᏛᏁ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏬᎮ Ꮫ ᎠᎩᎵᏏ Sallie JohnsonᏁ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ
segments.transliteration: osda yo tsigehv tla.. uh.. tsinusda gohi tsigi do hena tla yigelihe yulisdodi na.. gadvsgv asenv agilisi hena aginosehv hinasi tsigvyeyohvsga tsudalenvda dvtsasdelv hena advsgv tlesdi osda tsinidagalistani gohi tsigi wagatawe tsu.. uh.. uyotlv nigalisdihv hadvsgv tsadagasesdesdi hesdi gusdi duyugata na.. duyu.. duyugata nigehvna tsinanadvneha hesdi tsitsa.. hesdi tsitsateladi hesdi do tsigvyeyohvsga duyugadv nitsadvnehesdi sinv osda yigi gusdi duyugadvne nv.. nv.. invdvne gohi tsigi awohe dv agilisi Sallie Johnsonne tsidudov
segments.translation: It was good but it’s not like that now. I didn’t know it was going to be like that when I was growing up, but my grandma told me these different things I am teaching you. It is going to help you when you grow up. What I’m teaching you is that it’s going to get better. It’s going to get worse. You need to watch yourself. Don’t be getting involved in the wrong things people are doing. What I’m teaching you is to do the right thing. It’s not good when you’re not doing the right things these days. It’s what my granny told me. Her name was Sally Johnson.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎤᏂᎪᏓᏍ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᎮ ᎥᎾ
segments.transliteration: nahiyu tsigehv unigodas yvwi danehe vna
segments.translation: At that time, was there more people living there?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: ᏙᏛᏲ Ꭺ.. i mean.. Ꭸ.. ᎤᏂᏥᏈᏍᏛ ᏣᏁ man ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓᏛ ᏯᏂᎷᎦ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᏎᏅ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏓᎨᎯᏙᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ BeebᏅ ᏣᏃᎮᎲ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏍᎩᏅ uh.. ᏓᎨᏠᎲ Ꮫ ᏍᎩᏅ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᏩ Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᏍᎪ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ Ꮭ ᎡᎵ.. Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏯᎩᏛᎦᏅ ᏱᎨᎲ ᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ..b.. ᎤᏖᏓ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏩᏛᎯᏍᏛᏅ
segments.transliteration: dodvyo go.. i mean.. ge.. unitsiquisdv tsane man tsudalenvdadv yaniluga tsigehv asenv tla ilvhiyu dagehidohe sgina Beebnv tsanohehv tsalagi gvdi dudov sginv uh.. dagetlohv dv sginv tla ilvhiyu gilo yitsiwa tla squu nigalisdi tsinaniwesgo gohi tsigi tla eli.. tla ilvhiyu yagidvganv yigehv sgi nigawesgv ..b.. uteda agayvlige awadvhisdvnv
segments.translation: Yeah, there was a lot of people. Man, different kind of people came there back then. But she never ran them off. Her Cherokee name was Beeb. She feed them. I never did see her being hateful, I never heard her say anythings hateful. That awesome old lady that raised me.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ.. ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎾᏗ ᎨᎮ ᏥᏫᏂ ᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ Ꮎ ᏚᏙᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏥᏈᏍᏗ ᎮᎾ ᏚᏙᏢᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙᎲᎨ ᎢᏣᏑᏂᏙᎮ ᏙᎨ
segments.transliteration: donv usdi.. donv usdi gadvnadi gehe tsiwini nasdv una ditlv na dudodawadisv tsiquisdi hena dudotlvsv ale itsinohalidohvge itsasunidohe doge
segments.translation: What was there to do every day when you were a young man that way every day? Because there is a lot of places and were you all hunting or fishing around?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Yeah, ᏂᎪᎸ ᏛᏲ uh.. ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ my grandpa uh.. Parker Johnson ᏚᏙᎥ ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ ᏂᎪᎸᏛ ᏦᏍᏓᏑᏂᏙᎲ ᎣᏍ.. ᎣᏍᏗᏃᎭᎵᏙᎲᏅ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏒ ᎬᏟ ᏙᎩᏂᏲᎲ and uh.. yeah, ᏥᏍᏓᏲ i mean.. ᏃᎴ ᎪᎢ ᏗᏢ baseball ᏦᏣᏁᎶᎲᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᏅ yeah, ᏙᏛ Ᏺ ᎤᏖᏗ Ᏺ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᎪᎯᎦ ᏥᏄᏍᏓ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᎯᏳ Ꮩ ᎫᏍᏗ ᎮᏍᏗ ᏍᏊ ᏍᏓᏱ ᎬᏂᏍᏚᎲᏍᎬ Ꮩ uh.. ᏥᏂ.. Ꮷ.. ᏗᏍᏚᏗ Ꮩ ᎮᎾ Ᏻ.. ᏲᎦᏂᎩᏍᏗ ᏙᎢᏅ ᏣᏍᏚᎲ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᎵᎮ ᏍᎩ.. ᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏂᏒ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, nigolv dvyo uh.. sgi hena my grandpa uh.. Parker Johnson dudov sgi hena nigolvdv tsosdasunidohv os.. osdinohalidohvnv nole usv gvtli doginiyohv and uh.. yeah, tsisdayo i mean.. nole goi ditlv baseball tsotsanelohvsgv sginv yeah, dodv yo utedi yo tsigehv gohigi tsigehv tla gohiga tsinusda yinusde nahiyu do gusdi hesdi squu sdayi gvnisduhvsgv do uh.. tsini.. tsu.. disdudi do hena yu.. yoganigisdi doinv tsasduhv tla ilvhiyu yigelihe sgi.. sgi nigalisdanisv
segments.translation: Yeah, all time, my grandpa, Parker Johnson was his name. We were always fishing and hunting. And at night we hunted coons. And yeah, a lot and then we would play baseball outside. Yeah, it was awesome back then, long time ago. It’s not like that nowadays, like it was. Really. They weren’t ever locking the doors. When we would leave, the doors wouldn’t be locked. I didn’t think it would ever get that way.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏙᏳ ᏣᎾᏔᏍ ᎨᏅ ᏛᏛᏏᏗᏒ Ꮭ.. Ꮭ ᎰᏩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎲ ᏃᎴ ᏗᏝᏃᎮᏗ ᎤᏞ ᏃᎴ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏓᏴᎳᏛᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ Ꮵ.. ᏥᏄᏍᏗᏓ ᎡᎶ ᏤᎾ ᏩᎾ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏱᎬᏁ ᎨᎵᏍᎪ ᎠᏯ ᎤᎪᏓ ᏍᏓᏱ ᏂᎬᏁᎵ ᎢᎩᏩᎾᎦᎳᏍᏔᎾ
segments.transliteration: doyu tsanatas genv dvdvsidisv tla.. tla howa gilo uhv nole ditlanohedi utle nole squu adayvladvsgi gohi tsigi tsi.. tsinusdida elo tsena wana ayelv yigvne gelisgo aya ugoda sdayi nigvneli igiwanagalastana
segments.translation: For real. You know, growing up nobody had a car or a telephone or a TV. And nowadays the way things are, it’s supposed to make everything easier. I think that it’s made it harder and made us weaker.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yeah, really.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: uh.. ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ uh.. ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏁᎲ uh.. ᏙᎯᏳ ᎮᎾ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎤᏛᏒ ᏍᎩᏍ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎫᏍᏗ ᏍᏊ ᎭᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏂᏙᎸ
segments.transliteration: uh.. nahiyu tsigehv uh.. anigayvli tsanehv uh.. dohiyu hena inage udvsv sgis yusdi gusdi squu hanadadisgo tsalisdanidolv
segments.translation: And back then when the elders were alive, the things that grew in the woods, things like that, that you remember eating.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: ᏂᎪᎸ Ꮫ Ꭶ.. ᎾᏛ Ꮧ.. ᏗᏪᏥ ᎠᏂ.. ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎰ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗᏓ Ꮭ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ Ꮵ.. ᎠᏯ ᏥᎦᏛᏍᎬ ᏥᏲᎮ ᎾᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ ᏌᎶᎵ ᏥᏍᏆ i mean.. ᏥᏍᏚ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᎫᏍᏗ ᏙᏥᎯᎲ Ꭳ.. Ꭳ.. ᎣᏨᏂᏍᏗᎲ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏓᏂᏲᎱᏍᎬ Ꮫ ᏱᏣ.. ᎠᎾᏛᏗᏍᎪ ᏥᏲᎮᎲ Ꮮ.. Ꮮ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎥᎾ ᎥᎩᎵᏏ ᎤᏚᏓ ᏍᎪᎯᏥ ᏅᎩ ᏳᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏍᎩᏅ Ꮭ.. Ꮭ.. ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ Ꮭ ᏍᎩ Ꭺ.. i mean.. ᎢᎦᏚ ᏍᎩ ᏳᎾᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᎨᎰ ᏃᏭᏅ ᏭᎾ ᏕᎨᎲ cancer Ꮫ ᏭᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏂᎯᎯ ᏴᏫ
segments.transliteration: nigolv dv ga.. nadv di.. diwetsi ani.. diniyotli gatsiyoheho gohi tsigi gohi tsigi tsinusdida tla sgi yinusdi tsi.. aya tsigadvsgv tsiyohe nawetsi atsutsa saloli tsisqua i mean.. tsisdu tsudalenvda gusdi dotsihihv o.. o.. otsvnisdihv gohi tsigi daniyohusgv dv yitsa.. anadvdisgo tsiyohehv tle.. tle sgi nusdi gohigi tsigehv vna vgilisi ududa sgohitsi nvgi yudetiyvda tsigehv tsuyohusv sginv tla.. tla.. gohi tsigi tla sgi go.. i mean.. igadu sgi yunadetiyvda geho nowunv wuna degehv cancer dv wutsiquisda gohi tsigi dunihihi yvwi
segments.translation: All the time, I tell my kids the way it is now is not what it used to be like. When I was growing up I told my son. Squirrels, birds, I mean rabbits. We killed all kinds of things, and we cooked. And these days all you hear is people dying. It wasn’t like that a long time ago. My grandma’s grandpa was 104 when he died. segments.translation: That’s what you’re talking about. The air conditioner, if we didn’t have those, we’d all pass out.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Boy.. ᏍᎩᏛ ᎾᏭᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ fan ᏥᏚᎲ ᏥᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎾᎴᏱᎩ ᎾᏭ ᎣᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ Ꮎ ᏚᎶᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏕᎳ ᎪᏢᏍᎬ ᏧᏩᏒ Ꮎ cooler Ꮎ window ᏱᎬᎾ ᎤᏁᏍᏓᎳᏭ ᏥᎦᏢᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏌᏴᏟ ᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ
segments.transliteration: Boy.. sgidv nawunv usdi fan tsiduhv tsigohigi tsigehv naleyigi nawu osdi tsudalenvda na dulowisdanehv adela gotlvsgv tsuwasv na cooler na window yigvna unesdalawu tsigatlvsgv unesayvtli yulisdodi
segments.translation: Boy, yeah. They used to just have the little fans. A long time ago, when she started working good and making money, she bought a cooler. That went in the window and she would just put ice in it. So it would get cool.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: [laughter]

segments.translation: [laughter]

segments.text: ... ᏙᎯᏳ ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮎ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᎴᏅ oh ᏏᎸ Ꭿ.. ᎯᎳᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᏝᏅᏢ ᏂᎯ

segments.translation: And really. What you started earlier, oh wait.. how many siblings do you have?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Uh.. Ꮎ ᏦᎢ Ꮶ.. Ꮶ.. ᏦᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᏌᏊ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ‘09 ᏥᎨᎲ ᎾᎾ uh.. ᏌᏊ ᎥᎩᏙ ᎠᎩᎧ ᎯᏍᎩ Ꮫ ᏥᏃᏥᏅ
segments.transliteration: Uh.. na tsoi tso.. tso.. tsotsadanvtli saquu tsuyohusv ‘09 tsigehv nana uh.. saquu vgido agika hisgi dv tsinotsinv
segments.translation: Uh.. Three brothers and one passed away in ‘09. And I have one sister. There were five of us.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Five. Four of y’all are still alive.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Uh.. Yep.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Are you the oldest?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Uh-huh, yep.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏩᎾ Ꮎ ᎪᎢ ᏣᎴᏅ uh.. Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕ uh.. ᎠᏯ.. ᎤᏂᏥᏈᏍᏗᎨ ᎨᎮ ᎠᏂᏐ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ

segments.translation: When you started at Greasy, what was it like? Was there a lot of other Cherokees?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Yeah, ᎡᎵ.. ᎡᎵᏛ ᎢᎸᏍᏗ Ᏸ.. ᏥᎨᎲ Ᏺ ᎢᎸᏍᏗᏛ ᏲᏥ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏦᏥᏬᏂᎲ ᏦᏣᏕᎶᏆᎥ ᏍᎩᏅ Ꮎ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏣᏁᏦᏍᎬ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏲᏁᎦ ᏲᏥᏬᏂᎲ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, eli.. elidv ilvsdi ye.. tsigehv yo ilvsdidv yotsi tsigehv tsalagi tsotsiwonihv tsotsadeloquav sginv na squu otsanetsosgv tla ilvhiyu yonega yotsiwonihv
segments.translation: Yeah, there were quite a few. A lot of us were talking Cherokee, when we were going to school and playing ball. We never did talk English.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: It was great back then.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Boy ᏴᏗᏪ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎰ man ᏯᏩᏚᎳᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎦ ᏲᏁ.. ᎩᎶ ᎮᎾ ᎦᏥᏩᏛᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎬᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏲ ᏲᏁᎦ ᎦᏥᏬᏂ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᏛ
segments.transliteration: Boy yvdiwe sgina gatsiyoheho man yawaduladi gohi tsiga yone.. gilo hena gatsiwadvdi tsalagi gvwonihisdi yigi tla ilvhiyuyo yonega gatsiwoni gatsiyohedv
segments.translation: Boy you said it! That’s what I tell them. Man, these days I wish I could visit people who can speak Cherokee. I would never talk English, I would tell them.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎾ ahem ᎾᎾ ᎡᏣᏙᎠ Ᏺ Ꮟ ᎠᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏗ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: nana ahem nana etsadoa yo si atsalagi gawonidi doha
segments.translation: What about your sister? She can still talk Cherokee, right?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: What about the boys?

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Ꮎ ᏯᏂᏧᏣ Ꮎ uh.. Ꮝ.. Ꮎ ᏭᏍᏗᎬ ᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᎦᎦᏬᏂ ᎭᏛᎩ..

segments.translation: Now the boys. The smallest one can’t speak.

segments.translation: What’s his name?

segments.translation: Jerry.

segments.transliteration: Uh.. dodvyo so gehv sgi ugi le yigi, hinohe yeah
segments.translation: Maybe the other one, you’re probably talking about u-gi.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Uh-huh.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yep, Wesley... yeah.

segments.translation: Now, what you’re talking about…when you played ball, when two talked Cherokee. I remember when they had tournaments in Vian.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.translation: It was basketball.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.text: ᎢᎦᏛ uh.. ᎦᏲᎵ ᎨᏍᏗ ᏍᎪᎯᏥᏉᏭ ᎤᎾᏓᎨᏒ ᏃᎴ.. Uh.. ᎭᏗ ᏍᏊ ᏯᏆᎾᏔ ᎯᎳᏴ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏒ.. Ꮵ.. ᏥᏗᏂᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮎ tournement ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ Cherokee County ᏃᎴ Adair County uh.. Sequoyah County Ꮎ feeder schools 8th grade ᏱᏫᏥᏓᏂᎷᎬ uh.. Ꮎ ᎨᏍ.. Ꮎ ᎨᏒ Bell Greasy uh.. Zion ᏃᎴ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ uh.. ᏂᎦᏓ ᏥᏓᏂᎷᎬ ᏥᎨᏒ and uh.. ᎠᏂᏴᏫᏯ Ꮫ ᎤᎪᏛ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏣᎳᎩ..
segments.transliteration: igadv uh.. gayoli gesdi sgohitsiquowu unadagesv nole.. Uh.. hadi squu yaquanata hilayv ani gesv.. tsi.. tsidinitloyasdi sgina na tournement nahiyu tsigesv asesgini gesv Cherokee County nole Adair County uh.. Sequoyah County na feeder schools 8th grade yiwitsidanilugv uh.. na ges.. na gesv Bell Greasy uh.. Zion nole tsuyohusv uh.. nigada tsidanilugv tsigesv and uh.. aniyvwiya dv ugodv tsigesv tsalagi..
segments.translation: There were just 100 pound tournaments. I don’t remember how many there were that were involved in that tournament at that time. Cherokee County, Adair County, Sequoyah County, and feeder schools up to the eighth grade. And that was Bell, Greasy, Zion, and Nicut. They would all come to that and there were a lot Indians.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Yep, really a long time ago.

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.text: ..ᏣᎳᎩ ᏯᏂᏕᏏᏙᎸ Ꮎ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏯᎾᏁᏦᏍᎬ ᎠᏯ ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: ..tsalagi yanidesidolv na tsalagi yananetsosgv aya ganvdadisgo
segments.translation: There would throw Cherokee around, I remember while they were playing.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Ᏺ.. Ᏺ.. ᏲᎦᏁᏦᎾᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ Cave Springs ᏦᎦᏕᎶᏆᎥ ᏱᎬᏩᎦᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ ᏙᎨ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏗ ᏴᏗ ᎾᏛ uh.. ᎣᏂ ᏗᏢ ᎦᏙᎬ Ꮎ ᎤᎦᏎᏍᏛ “ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎮ ᎨᎵ” ᏯᏓᎪᎮᎳ “Ꮭ ᎫᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏃᎯᏏ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᎾᏔ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎾ”
segments.transliteration: yo.. yo.. yoganetsonadv tsigehv na Cave Springs tsogadeloquav yigvwagadosdv tsigehv aniyonega doge usdi adi yvdi nadv uh.. oni ditlv gadogv na ugasesdv “aginohehe geli” yadagohela “tla gusdi gagvnohisi tla yawanata nigawesgv sgina”
segments.translation: We were playing ball when we went to school at Cave Springs. While we were playing, white people would be watching me wondering what I’m saying. The one that was behind me guarding me saying “I think he’s talking about me.” “I can’t tell you anything because I don’t know what he’s saying.”

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.translation: Yeah, I was really impressed that.. Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: ..yeah.. ..yeah..

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.translation: ..they were talking Cherokee.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Yeah, ᎮᏍᏗ Ꮫ.. Ꮎ ᏥᏂᏛᏅᏁᎰ signs Ꮭ ᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᏙᏍᏛᏁᎮ Ꮎ ᏕᏥᏂᏱᎲ ᏍᎩᏅ ᏣᎳᎩᏭ ᎣᏍᏗᏬᏂᎲ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, hesdi dv.. na tsinidvnvneho signs tla sgi yinadosdvnehe na detsiniyihv sginv tsalagiwu osdiwonihv
segments.translation: Yeah, you know how they do the signs, we didn’t do that. Because I was a catcher and we would just be talking Cherokee.

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.translation: Yeah, yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: [laughter]

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: [laughter]

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.translation: [laughter]

segments.text: ᎾᎾ uh.. Ꭰ.. ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᏁᏍ ᏍᎩᏅ Ꮎ trailerᎢ ᏂᏥᏁᎴ
segments.transliteration: nana uh.. a.. osdv nitsadvnvnes sginv na traileri nitsinele
segments.translation: What about, y’all were doing good, living in that trailer.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Mhmm, yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: It had water.

segments.text: ᎣᏏᏛ ᎾᏭ ᏦᏣᎴᏅ ᏦᏣᏛᏍᎬ ᎾᏭ ᏧᏍᏗᎬ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏴ ᎾᏭ ᏍᎩᏅ ᎾᏭ uh.. ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮎ ᏦᎦᏁᏍᎨ ᎨᎵᏅ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏧᎾ.. ᏧᎾᏁᏍᎨ

segments.translation: It was good, but when we all started growing up, its was getting small. And that’s when they built us the Indian home.

segments.text: Ꭵ ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮎ ᏃᏭ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏓᏁᎳ

segments.translation: Is that the one that’s there right now?

segments.translation: Yep.

segments.text: ᎣᏏᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁ ᎠᏯ ᎮᎾ.. ..ᎠᏯ ᎮᎾ ᎡᏥ ᏦᏍᏕᎮ ᎮᏍᏗ ᎮᎾ ᎠᎹ ᏱᏂᏚᏍᏗ

segments.translation: I guess y’all had it good, but where me and my mom was at, we didn’t have water.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: Man.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Boy, the water was across the road.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.translation: You were hauling water.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: I was hauling water, yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: yep ᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏪᎮᏅ ᎠᎩᎵᏏ ᎪᎯᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏂᏓᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎳᏗᎾᎲ arthritis ᏚᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏕᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏓᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎯᎩᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᎹ ᏳᏟᏗ ᏙᏥᏂᏗᏫᏍᎬ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᎫᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᏛᎾ ᏙᎩᎰ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏞᏅ ᎪᎯᏥᎩ Ꮎ rubber boots ᏥᏚᎾᎳᎱᏢ ᎮᎾ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏙᎦ.. ᏙᎦᎳᎱᏢ ᏙᏅ ᏬᎦᏕᎵᎪᏭ ᏣᏬᎮᎲ ᎥᎥ ᎾᎾ Ꮎ ᏧᏪᏴ Ꮎ ᎥᎾ Ꮎ ᎠᎹᎦᏍᎦ ᎨᏓᎵ ᏗᏢᏅ ᏌᎷᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏪᏴ ᎡᎵᎦᏯᎨ ᏣᏨᏏᏰᏗ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: yep sgina tsawehenv agilisi gohigi tsigehv sgina sgini yusdi tsinidawalisdaneladinahv arthritis dulisdanehv degayesadv sgini yusdi tsidawalisdanehv gohigidv tsigehv ama yutlidi dotsinidiwisgv tsudalenvda gusdi tsisdvna dogiho atsadi leyigi tlenv gohitsigi na rubber boots tsidunalahutlv hena sgi yusdi doga.. dogalahutlv donv wogadeligowu tsawohehv vv nana na tsuweyv na vna na amagasga gedali ditlvnv salunigeyv tsuweyv eligayage tsatsvsiyedi doha
segments.translation: That’s what my grandma used to tell me a long time ago, that’s why she has arthritis in her fingers. We would just go in,” she would tell me.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎥᎥ ᎾᎾ Ꮎ ᏧᏪᏴ Ꮎ ᎥᎾ Ꮎ ᎠᎹᎦᏍᎦ ᎨᏓᎵ ᏗᏢᏅ ᏌᎷᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏪᏴᎡᎵᎦᏯᎨ ᏣᏨᏏᏰᏗ ᏙᎭ

segments.translation: What about the creek below Rainwater’s house, the Sallisaw Creek? You walked that a lot, ain’t it?

segments.text: boy ᏥᏈᏍᏛ Ᏺ ᎠᎩᏑᏂᏙᎸ ᏛᏲ ᏍᏊ...

segments.translation: Boy a lot! I’ve fished all around there.

segments.translation: Yeah, really.

segments.text: ...ᏂᎪ... ᏥᏈᏍᏓᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᏍᏙ.. ᎾᎮ ᎠᎩ.. Ꮎ.. my dad ᎤᏥ ᎨᏗ ᎥᎾ ᎮᎾ ᏥᎦᏁᎸ Ꮎ ᎥᎾ Ꮎ lake ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᎾ ᎠᏎᏅ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏁᏘᏏ ᏳᎦᎭᏂᎩ ᏛᏲ.. ᏛᏲᏟᎩ ᏗᏲ ᎩᎶ Ꮭ ᏰᎨ Ꮎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ .. Ꭴ.. ᎤᎾᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᏥᎪᏢ Ꮟ.. Ꮟ ᎮᎾ ᏝᏍ ᎠᏎ ᎩᎶ ᏰᏙᎰ ᎪᎯᏥᎩ
segments.transliteration: ...nigo... tsiquisdadv tsigehv na sdo.. nahe agi.. na.. my dad utsi gedi vna hena tsiganelv na vna na lake tsinusdi vna asenv nigohilv unetisi yugahanigi dvyo.. dvyotligi diyo gilo tla yege na nahiyu tsigehv na .. u.. unadawosdi tsigotlv si.. si hena tlas ase gilo yedoho gohitsigi
segments.translation: A lot back then. My dad’s mother, Ge-di she used to live there, where the lake is. There, where it used to rain a lot. Nobody was going anywhere.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ .. Ꭴ.. ᎤᎾᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᏥᎪᏢ Ꮟ.. Ꮟ ᎮᎾ ᏝᏍ ᎠᏎ ᎩᎶ ᏰᏙᎰ ᎪᎯᏥᎩ

segments.translation: And back then where they used to swim, I don’t guess any comes there anymore.

segments.speaker: michael-pritchett
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏃᏭ ᏣᎾᏗᎲ ᎤᏬᏎ Ꮫ Ꮎ ᎤᏔᎾ ᏅᏱ
segments.transliteration: tla nowu tsanadihv uwose dv na utana nvyi
